# Madhura Naturals

> Madhura Naturals is a premium South Indian organic food brand selling cold pressed oils, A2 desi cow ghee, organic millets, stone-ground flours and traditional staples. Everything is grown chemical-free on rain-fed farms around Zaheerabad, Telangana, made in small batches, lab tested, and delivered across India. Tagline: "Premium Organic Goodness."

## About

Madhura Naturals works with 200+ natural-farming families across Telangana, Andhra Pradesh and Karnataka. Oils are cold pressed on traditional wooden ghanis below 40°C; ghee is bilona-churned from the curd of grass-fed Gir and Sahiwal (A2) cows; flours and idly ravva are stone-milled in small weekly batches. Every pack is traceable to its farm cluster and carries a pressing or milling date. Certifications: India Organic (NPOP), FSSAI licensed. Every batch is lab tested for adulterants and heavy metals.

## Products

- Cold Pressed Oils: groundnut, sesame (gingelly/nallennai), coconut, safflower — wood-pressed, unrefined, no hexane or bleaching.
- A2 Ghee: bilona-method desi cow ghee, grainy and aromatic.
- Organic Sugar & Jaggery: unrefined country sugar and chemical-free jaggery powder.
- Millets: jowar (sorghum), ragi (finger millet), brown top millet — gluten-free, rain-fed.
- Flours & Atta: Kapli (emmer) atta, ragi flour, jonna pindi (sorghum flour).
- Idly Ravva: jonna (sorghum) and ragi idly ravva for soft, diabetic-friendly idlis.
- Spices & Traditionals: high-curcumin Salem turmeric, pure kumkum, inguva (asafoetida).
- Healthy Biscuits: ragi almond, millet jaggery, multigrain honey — no maida, no refined sugar.

## Shipping & Policies

Ships across India. Delivery: Telangana 1–3 days, South India 2–5 days, rest of India 4–7 days. Free shipping above ₹999 in most zones. Returns accepted within 7 days for unopened products; quality issues replaced on photo proof. Online payment; COD rolling out for select pincodes.
